heading: ஆங்கில மொழிபெயர்ப்பு
lines: On a huge Maturai street with multi storeyed Mansions
Of the two standing by me, one said
The gold plate was lovely; she is a good
Lady; the other one, of the same status, said
That the tusker was more beautious than
The gold plate; An unfortunate one, I said
That the garland worn by Tennan wielding
A bright, leaf-shaped spear and being
Seated on the tuskers back was superb.
